title: TRUST EROSION
body: Your trust score never fell in one dramatic moment. It fell the way trust does - a few wrong rejections, a few qualified people turned away, a rumour in the queue that HR rejects everyone with a gap on their page.
The honest candidates stop applying before you notice. The ones who stay are the ones who can afford to be rejected.
That is the version of a hiring desk you were supposed to prevent.
couldHaveDone: Read the cover letter on the applicants who looked odd. Most of the things you rejected were explainable, and the explanations were one click away.
